title: Crispy Gored-Gored with Pineapple and Nuka-Pickle
description: A flavorful and crispy Ethiopian dish featuring the perfect combination of pineapple chunks, nuka-pickle, and tender meat. Perfect for a weeknight dinner or a special occasion.

ingredients.name: 1 lb beef or lamb shoulder
ingredients.notes: You can also use a combination of beef and lamb for more flavor

instructions: In a large bowl, combine the meat, niter kibbeh or ghee, garlic, ginger, cumin, salt, and black pepper. Mix well to coat the meat evenly.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or up to 2 hours.
Remove the meat from the refrigerator and let it sit at room temperature for 15 minutes.
Add the pineapple chunks to the bowl and mix well to combine.
Heat a large skillet over high heat. Add the nuka-pickle and cook, stirring constantly, for 2-3 minutes or until lightly browned.
Add the meat and pineapple mixture to the skillet and cook, stirring constantly, for 2-3 minutes or until the meat is browned on all sides.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and cook for 15-20 minutes or until the meat is cooked through and the pineapple is caramelized.
Remove the skillet from the oven and garnish with chopped cilantro. Serve immediately.

Note: To make nuka-pickle, combine 2 cups of pickled turnips (or cauliflower) with 1 cup of water and 1 tablespoon of lemon juice in a blender. Blend until smooth. Strain the mixture through a fine-mesh sieve into a bowl. Discard the solids and refrigerate the nuka-pickle for at least 30 minutes before using.
